not_a_term: A reading, not a change to what the bounty promises. The campaign's own text is unchanged and no hash has ever been published in it — nothing the 2026-09-08 rebuild could have falsified. Recorded independently of misquote-c2, which took the same reading; both agree on all four values.
open_question_for_a_human: Whether a claimant who hashed before the 2026-09-08 rebuild and reports a mismatch should be paid. The honest reading is that they found something true and the bounty is working. Not decided here.
why: The bounty in packages/misquote/registry/marketplace.py pays a claimant to hash this URL and report what it says. The file is not frozen: a claimant hashes at T and we judge at T+n, and `make showcase` in between makes their hash legitimately right and no longer equal to ours. It moved twice on 2026-09-08 alone. This is the reading a claim can be adjudicated against, so a mismatch can be resolved by asking which reading they took rather than by assuming they are wrong.
